questions.question: A defective dining set costing Rs. 10000 is being sold at 10% loss. If the price is further reduced successively by 5%, then the selling price is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Successive reduction formula can be directly applied to the initial cost to find the final selling price.

Selling Price (SP) = CP × [(100 − L₁) ÷ 100] × [(100 − L₂) ÷ 100]

SP = 10000 × (90 ÷ 100) × (95 ÷ 100)

SP = 10000 × 0.90 × 0.95 = 8550

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/594cd4ff8bead22426fbc77fc99fdd0a1cd8a9fd7816981c71d07240313c769c.png] 

**Given:**

Initial Cost Price of dining set = ₹10000

Loss percentage = 10%

Successive reduction percentage = 5%

**Calculations:**

⇒ Price after 10% loss = 10000 − (10% of 10000)

⇒ Price after 10% loss = 10000 − 1000 = ₹9000

⇒ Final Selling Price after further 5% reduction = 9000 − (5% of 9000)

⇒ Final Selling Price = 9000 − 450 = ₹8550

**∴ The correct answer is ₹8550.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Successive Reduction

When two successive reductions of a% and b% are applied, the net equivalent reduction percentage is given by the formula: (a + b − a × b ÷ 100)%.

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit and Loss are always computed on the Cost Price (CP) unless specifically stated otherwise. SP = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss)% ÷ 100.

Marked Price vs Selling Price

A discount is always offered on the Marked Price (MP) of an article. Selling Price (SP) = MP × (100 − Discount)% ÷ 100.

questions.question: 9 boys and 12 men can complete a work in 24 days. Each boy takes thrice the time taken by a man to complete the work. In how many days will 15 men complete the same work?

Speed × Time = Distance

Time taken to cross the bridge = 85 sec.

Speed = 72 kmph = (72 × 5)/18 = 20 m/sec.

To cross the bridge, the train needs to travel = Length of train + length of bridge = 1000 + x

Speed × Time = Distance

20 × 85 = 1000 + x

⇒ x = 1700 – 1000 = 700

∴ Length of the bridge = 700 m.

questions.question: The average height of 40 sticks is 156 cm. Some sticks of average height 162 cm are taken out. If the new average height is 150 cm, then how many sticks are remaining?
questions.solution:
Given:

The average height of 40 sticks is 154 cm

Formula used

Average = Sum of all values/Total no. of values

Calculation:

Average of 40 sticks = (Sum of Length of 40 sticks) /40

⇒ 156 = (sum of length 40 sticks) /40

⇒ Sum of length 40 sticks = 6240

Let x sticks be taken out

Average of x sticks = (sum of length of x stick) /x

⇒ 162 = (sum of length of x sticks) /x

⇒ Sum of length of x sticks = 162x

Now, Remaining sticks = 40 - x

Average of (40 - x) sticks = {sum of length of (40 - x) stick} /(40 - x)

⇒ 150 = {sum of length of (40 - x) sticks} /(40 - x)

⇒ Sum of length of (40 - x) sticks = 150(40 - x) = 6000 - 150x

According to the question,

⇒ 162x + 6000 - 150x = 6240

⇒ 12x = 240

⇒ x = 20

Remaining sticks = 40 - x = 40 - 20 = 20

∴ The correct answer is 24.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** 

Calculation:

Combined average = (n₁x₁ + n₂x₂)/(n₁ + n₂)

⇒ 156 = [162n + 150(40 - n)]/40

⇒ 6240 = 162n - 150n + 6000

⇒ 12n = 240

⇒ n = 20

Remaining sticks = 40 - n = 40 - 20 = 20

∴ The correct answer is 20.
